title: Unlearning That Lasts: Utility-Preserving, Robust, and Almost Irreversible Forgetting in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2509.02820v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Unlearning in large language models (LLMs) requires precisely removing specific information from a pre-trained model, e.g. to delete private data or harmful knowledge acquired during pre-training. However, existing unlearning methods often fall short under thorough evaluation. This paper makes three contributions. First, we introduce JensUn, a novel unlearning approach which leverages the Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD) as the training objective for both forget and retain sets. We provide theoretical arguments why JSD outperforms KL-Divergence, and show in extensive experiments that JensUn achieves the best forget-utility trade-off and demonstrates strong resilience to benign relearning, outperforming existing methods. Second, for a precise unlearning evaluation, we introduce LPF, a curated dataset of less prominent facts that provides a realistic unlearning scenario. translated_title: 持久遗忘：大语言模型中保持效用、鲁棒且几乎不可逆的遗忘
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）中的遗忘（unlearning）要求从预训练模型中精确移除特定信息，例如删除预训练过程中获取的隐私数据或有害知识。然而，现有遗忘方法在严格评估下往往表现不佳。本文做出三项贡献。首先，我们提出JensUn，一种新颖的遗忘方法，它将Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD）作为遗忘集和保留集的训练目标。我们提供了理论论证说明JSD为何优于KL散度，并通过大量实验证明JensUn实现了最佳的遗忘-效用权衡，且对良性再学习表现出强韧性，超越了现有方法。其次，为了进行精确的遗忘评估，我们引入了LPF，一个精心整理的、由不那么显著的事实构成的数据集，提供了贴近现实的遗忘评估场景。第三，为了全面测试遗忘方法，我们（i）……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出基于Jensen-Shannon散度的新型遗忘方法JensUn，在大语言模型中实现保持效用、鲁棒且几乎不可逆的持久遗忘，并引入LPF数据集以支持精确而贴近现实的遗忘评估。
en_tdlr: JensUn leverages Jensen-Shannon Divergence as a training objective to achieve utility-preserving, robust, and almost irreversible unlearning in LLMs, complemented by the LPF dataset for precise and realistic unlearning evaluation.
